snippet_primary: "Lately, in the past couple of months, I have been buying a lot of inexpensive copper wire wrapped jewelry, as well as sterling silver. I have never had a problem with this site until yesterday when I tried to log on and was informed my account has been 'permanently suspended.' My reaction is WTF as I still have over 30 outstanding orders that I am no longer able to track."
